Name: Joja Seeds Redux for 1.6
Author: dark8807
Description:
[left]Rebuilt for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8746]Joja Seeds[/url] 1.6 with explicit permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114762643]CopperSun[/url] .[/left]
[left]This version completely removes legacy dependencies, including Json Assets (JA), Shop Tile Framework (STF), and Producer Framework Mod (PFM). Now runs purely on Content Patcher![/left]
[left]Important Notes & Compatibility[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Details & Growth Cycles: For full mod details, please refer to the original mod page. Note that I have adjusted certain crop growth cycles that were inaccurate in the current game version to make them more balanced and rewarding.[/left]

[left]SVE Compatible: Fully tested and compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.[/left]

[left]Android / Mobile: Compatibility is unconfirmed as I do not play on Android.
If anyone is willing to test it on mobile, feedback is welcome!

[center]   
[b][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50846/50846-1788084651-1501496670.png[/img]
[color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS]3x Joja Corn ➔ Charcoal Kiln ➔ 5x Coal[/font][/color][/size]
[/b][size=4]
[i][color=#ffffff][size=4]使用三个JOJA玉米到煤炭窑 可产生5个煤炭[/size][/color][/i][/size][/center]
[/left]

[left]Development & Future Plans This is my first time refactoring and remaking a mod.
If you encounter any bugs, please be patient—fixes might take some time.

(However, I’ve been running this smoothly alongside my personal load order of 900+ mods, so hopefully your setup won't be worse than mine!)[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]More 1.6 Joja Crops: Bringing the remaining crops from the 1.6 update into Joja variants!
Added the Year 2 Joja series crops.[/left]


经 [b]CopperSun[/b] 正式授权，针对 1.6 版本重新构建了 [b]Joja Seeds[/b]。 本版本彻底去除了旧版的前置依赖，包括 Json Assets (JA)、Shop Tile Framework (STF) 以及 Producer Framework Mod (PFM)。现在完全基于 Content Patcher 独立运行！
[b]重要说明与兼容性[/b]
[list]
[*][b]详细信息与生长周期[/b]：完整的 Mod 详情请参考原版页面。需要说明的是，我微调了部分在当前游戏版本中不够准确的作物生长周期，使其更加平衡且更具收获感。[/*]
[*][b]SVE 兼容性[/b]：已通过完整测试，与 Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) 完全兼容。[/*]
[*][b]Android / 移动端[/b]：由于我本人不在安卓端游玩，因此移动端兼容性尚未确认。如果有玩家愿意在手机上测试并反馈，非常欢迎！[/*]
[/list][b]开发与未来计划[/b]
[list]
[*]这是我第一次重构并重制 Mod。如果遇到任何 Bug，还请多一些耐心——修复可能需要一点时间。（不过我自己搭配了 900+ 个 Mod 的模组列表一直在流畅运行，相信你的环境应该不会比我的更糟！）[/*]
[*][b]更多 1.6 Joja 作物[/b]：后续会将 1.6 更新中剩余的作物也陆续制作成 Joja 变体！[/*]
[*]添加第二年的Joja 系列 作物 [/*]
[/list][center][b][i][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffd966]
[size=6]1.6 is the ultimate era for Joja mods.[/size]
[size=5] 1.6 版本，是属于 Joja ＭＯＤ的鼎盛时代。 [/size][/color]
